milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The stone brick front wall is at z=4 spawn-relative, centered at (0, 1, 4). The player spawns at (0, 0, 0), which is ~4.1 blocks from the target. With max_distance=3, the player MUST walk forward 1-2 blocks toward the corridor entrance before this triggers (4.1 > 3, so it cannot auto-complete at spawn). The facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is looking toward the stone bricks. This preserves the sequential dependency: the player actively approaches and observes the stone brick structure before proceeding inside.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/observe task. The polished granite stairs span z=11-13 in three tiers, centered at (0, 1, 12) spawn-relative. With max_distance=5, the player must be at least at z≈7 or deeper inside the corridor while facing the stairs. This requires navigating through the entire stone brick corridor (~12 blocks from spawn) to reach the far end. The facing_tolerance of 60° ensures the player is actually looking at the stairs, not just passing by. The 5-block distance is appropriate because the stairs are visually prominent (pinkish-brown against gray stone bricks) and can be identified from a few blocks away inside the lit corridor.
